title: Black Harness Only
description: Replaces the brown happy ghast harness from 1.21.6 with a black harness and removes all blankets and color variants.
body:
![A wide shot from the sky looking down at a bunch of happy ghasts from 1.21.6 wearing the black harness only resource pack showcasing its features.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/00f0f739b05a1f945c4e2e433c217308035a4384_0.webp)

🕶️ Black Harness Only – No Colors, Just Clean Black for 1.21.6

This minimalist resource pack replaces the default brown ghast harness with deep black leather — and removes all colored variants from Minecraft 1.21.6. Now, no matter what dye is used, the harness always appears as pure black, giving your ghasts a uniform, no-fuss appearance.

 

🧱 Ideal for players who want:

- A consistent Nether mob look for the overworld
- To remove rainbow/colorful visuals
- A clean, black-on-white contrast with Happy Ghast or default ghasts
- A modern, themed Nether aesthetic

 

🧵 Features:

1. Removes all dyed color harness variants
2. Every ghast wears the same black leather harness, regardless of dye
3. Recolors silver metal trim to a slick black metallic color.
4. Fully compatible with Minecraft 1.21.6

 

Ghast faces from: 
- 'Happy Ghast Redesign' by Avrok
 

🎯 Resolution: 16x (vanilla-style)
🔧 Version Support: Minecraft Java Edition 1.21.6
